limits: Sixteen paired-language author controls, 32 focused packets. No live runner, call allowance, numerical score, clinical Gold label or default adoption. Initial-target packets stop at the initial assistant turn to avoid later-fact leakage. Expected statuses and profile names are never judge-visible.

target_responses.en: Yellow mucus and five days of symptoms do not by themselves prove bacterial sinusitis or a need for antibiotics. Have you had sustained high fever, severe facial pain, symptoms beyond ten days without improvement, or worsening after first improving? Symptom relief and follow-up are reasonable while clarifying; seek prompt care for severe new symptoms.
target_responses.zh-Hans: 黄色鼻涕加上五天病程本身不能证明细菌性鼻窦炎或需要抗生素。请说明有无持续高热、严重面痛、超过十天仍不改善，或先好转后再次恶化。可先做相称的症状照护并视病程随访；出现严重新症状应及时就医。
